models.name: pardot__campaigns
models.description: Each record represents a campaign in Pardot

columns.name: _fivetran_deleted
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the record has been deleted in the source system.

columns.name: count_opportunities
columns.description: Count of all campaign opportunities. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

columns.name: count_opportunities_won
columns.description: Count of all campaign opportunities won. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

columns.name: count_opportunities_lost
columns.description: Count of all campaign opportunities lost. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

models.name: pardot__lists
models.description: Each record represents a list in Pardot.

columns.name: is_crm_visible
columns.description: If true, list is visible in CRM to add or remove from

columns.name: is_public
columns.description: If true, list will show on EPC pages to prospects

columns.name: is_dynamic
columns.description: If true, list has prospects dynamically added to it via a set of chosen rules

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Time list is created in Pardot.

columns.name: count_activity_emails
columns.description: Count of email activities associated with the members of the list. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

columns.name: count_activity_visits
columns.description: Count of visit activities associated with the members of the list. An visit activity refers to type_name = 'visit'. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

models.name: pardot__opportunities
models.description: Each record represents an opportunity in Pardot.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: Pardot ID of the campaign associated with this opportunity

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Time opportunity is created in Pardot

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Last time opportunity was updated in Pardot

columns.name: count_prospects
columns.description: Number of prospects associated with the opportunity. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

models.name: pardot__prospects
models.description: Each record in the table represents a prospect in Pardot.

columns.name: _fivetran_deleted
columns.description: Boolean representing whether the record has been deleted in the source system.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: Pardot ID of the campaign associated with this prospect

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Time prospect is created in Pardot; Time is reported in API user's preferred timezone

columns.name: crm_account_fid
columns.description: Account ID in a supported CRM system

columns.name: crm_contact_fid
columns.description: Prospect's contact ID in a supported CRM system

columns.name: crm_last_sync
columns.description: Last time this prospect was synced with a supported CRM system

columns.name: crm_lead_fid
columns.description: Prospect's lead ID in a supported CRM system

columns.name: crm_owner_fid
columns.description: Prospect's owner ID in a supported CRM system

columns.name: crm_url
columns.description: URL to view the prospect within the CRM system

columns.name: is_do_not_call
columns.description: If value is 1, prospect prefers not to be called

columns.name: is_do_not_email
columns.description: If value is 1, prospect prefers not to be emailed

columns.name: is_reviewed
columns.description: If value is 1, prospect has been reviewed

columns.name: is_starred
columns.description: If value is 1, prospect has been starred

columns.name: last_activity_at
columns.description: Time stamp of this prospect's latest visitor activity; Time is reported in API user's preferred timezone

columns.name: opted_out
columns.description: If value is 1, prospect has opted out of marketing communications

columns.name: recent_interaction
columns.description: Describes the prospect's most recent interaction with Pardot

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Last time prospect was updated in Pardot; Time is reported in API user's preferred timezone

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Pardot ID of the user associated with this prospect

columns.name: years_in_business
columns.description: Prospect's number of years in business

columns.name: count_activity_visits
columns.description: Count of visit activities associated with the prospect. An visit activity refers to type_name = 'visit'. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.

columns.name: count_activity_emails
columns.description: Count of email activities associated with the prospect. Set the value to 0 if it is NULL.
